text.p: Severe flooding is ongoing in the US North Plains across many river systems. Milder temperatures are quickening snowmelt and producing even more severe flooding. Many rivers are at all-time record crests. Similar conditions are developing in southern Manitoba, Canada, where the worst flooding in many years is expected to occur. No heavy rain or snow is forecast for these areas during the next 3 to 5 days.

Typhoon Isa, with 130 mph winds, is southwest of the Mariana Islands near 13.4n/140.2e, moving west northwest at 8 mph. Isa is a major threat to shipping but no longer threatens the islands. Isa is expected to weaken slowly and curve more to the north then northeast during the next few days.

Tropical Cyclone Ian, with 60 mph winds, is over the southern Pacific and has just crossed the dateline near 21.0s. Ian is moving east southeast at 20 mph and is expected to continue this track, weakening, and dissipating over open water within 48 hours.
